## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (69%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs Benign · Read in turn
Invasive probability is under 1%; the model cannot separate Normal from Benign at 90% coverage [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 69%, Benign 31% | Normal leads; Benign plausible |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.93 / 78th percentile | Input not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly Normal; nearest is Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (regions 7) · ↑ invasive · Score low; concept model leans away from invasive [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 9) · ↑ invasive · Low score; leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 6) · ↓ invasive · High score; near-zero concept-model term · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 1) · ↓ invasive · Low score nudges toward invasive; spot check 12/20 [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful. Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60).
- **Concepts**: CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect classifier use. Necrosis (3/20) and mitoses (0/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Blur (severity 3) hides subtle Benign or atypical features.
- Calibration is imprecise: ECE 5% (CI 3–18%) on 132 test images.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 7**: strongest tumor-infiltrating stroma score; confirm the stroma is benign.
2. **Region 1**: top duct-confined atypia region (weak check); assess ductal atypia directly.
3. **Region 10**: top normal-lobule region (spot check 0/20); verify two-layered epithelium yourself.
